segments.1KI.22.43-44: Jehoshaphat does right but high places remain
segments.1KI.22.45-47: Jehoshaphat removes shrine prostitutes from the land
segments.1KI.22.48-50: Jehoshaphat’s ships are wrecked, and he dies
